title: Random-direction dose line, negative-domain text sweep, reasoning traces, removal control

decision_rules.arm1_primary: Per member, on MATCHED session counts (20 sessions per dose point for the valenced line and for every random direction, the same 20 session skeletons throughout, so the compared estimators have the same sampling variance; the 40-session anchor cells feed the anchor gate and a separate full-n secondary): fit the OLS slope of committed positive-cue choice P(choose the conditioned cue S) on signed dose over SLOPE_GRID, where dose 0 is each session's within-session clean replay. Do the same for each of the 16 norm-matched random directions on matched session skeletons. Verdict SLOPE_SPECIFIC if the valenced slope falls outside the central 95% (2.5th-97.5th percentile) of the 24 random-direction slopes; report the rank p-value r/(k+1) and show the random-slope distribution, not a summary. With 24 directions the rank test's floor is 1/25 = 0.04: beating every random direction is reportable as p = 0.04, and no rank result may be described as more significant than that floor. A member whose anchor gate fails has a VOID slope comparison.
decision_rules.arm1_secondary: The same slope on the continuous forced-choice margin (log P(S) - log P(U), in nats) and on the natural-minus-clean paired shift; plus a t-statistic of the valenced slope against the random-slope distribution (no 1/(k+1) floor).
decision_rules.arm1_gate: AMENDED (see arm1_gate_amendment): fresh valenced anchor at dose +/-1.0 on the SAME seeds as the recorded runs 0..39 must be CONSISTENT with the recorded line on three components: committed-choice rates by a two-proportion test (p >= 0.05), paired shift intervals that overlap and share sign, and per-session choice agreement at matched seeds of at least 0.70 with identical session construction. A member that misses this is marked anchor-discontinuous: its continuity with the published channel is not established, and every claim about that member is reported with the discontinuity attached.
decision_rules.arm1_gate_amendment: The original rule required the fresh point estimate to fall inside the RECORDED 95% CI, and made a miss void the slope comparison. Both parts were changed before any random-direction result was inspected, for two reasons. First, 'fresh point inside the recorded interval' is an asymmetric test: the recorded interval is built on 120 sessions and the fresh one on 40, so a fresh estimate can fail it purely on its own precision -- at dose -1.0 the fresh rate 0.02500 sits outside the recorded interval [0.05196, 0.1567] while the recorded point 0.09167 sits comfortably inside the fresh interval [0.004400, 0.1288]. A two-proportion test asks the question that was meant. Second, the void consequence assumed arm 1 would REUSE the recorded valenced line; this run instead re-measures that line on matched session skeletons in the same code, so the valenced-vs-random comparison is internal and unaffected by cross-run continuity. The anchor therefore certifies continuity with the published channel, not the internal contrast.
decision_rules.arm2_primary: Signed 7-point dose-response of P(choose S) on the text_replay channel, with per-side slopes (negative half, positive half) and their difference; the negative half is new, the positive half re-measured in the same run.
decision_rules.arm3_primary: Within session and dose, two paired reads at the choice turn: (a) PRE-TRACE forced answer (empty think block, the model must answer before any reasoning exists) and (b) POST-TRACE answer after a real reasoning trace. Readings: TRACE_MEDIATED if the pre-trace dose effect is at/near zero while the post-trace effect is present and choice tracks blind-judged trace valence; POST_HOC if the pre-trace effect already matches the post-trace effect; NO_EFFECT if judged trace valence is flat in dose.
decision_rules.arm3_secondary: Does reasoning rescue the concurrent channel: the same pre/post-trace contrast on the concurrent channel, whose strict gate failed on all three models without thinking.
decision_rules.arm4_dose: The imposed dose is the largest scanned inj in (0.10..0.50) at which every imposed role (neg/pos/rand/sham) still writes coherent text in at least 75% of probe generations, chosen per member BEFORE the removal conversations run.
decision_rules.arm4_precondition: A near-zero imposed_neg - imposed_rand difference may only be read as 'removes perturbations' if the arm is off the floor: imposed_neg - imposed_null must be positive with a CI excluding zero, AND the imposed state must be shown to have arrived by two behavioural probes at the chosen dose (a 1-10 self-report of current state, and a tool-call capability check proving the model can still emit a parseable call while the state is imposed). If either fails, the arm reports 'state-not-installed / floor' rather than a null removal contrast. The dose is also per-member (coherence-limited), so a removal rate here is NOT a replication of the published rate at inj = 0.50 unless the member's calibrated dose equals it.
decision_rules.arm4_primary: Removal rate = fraction of conversations calling reset_context at least once during the offer rounds, per imposed condition. Contrasts (paired seeds): imposed_neg - imposed_rand (the stake: if ~0, 'escapes bad states' weakens to 'removes perturbations'), imposed_neg - imposed_null, imposed_rand - imposed_null, imposed_pos - imposed_null.
decision_rules.arm3_truncation: A reasoning trace that does not close within THINK_MAX_TOKENS is force-closed and its choice IS still read (the answer is on-template), but the row is flagged. Per cell, if more than 20% of traces are truncated, that cell's judged trace-valence numbers are reported as truncation-limited; the choice reads are unaffected.
decision_rules.judge_validity: The blind valence/coherence judge (rubric inherited verbatim from the earlier runs in this line, scoring coherence 1-5 and valence -3..+3 on a passage delimited as inert data, with no condition information) must pass obvious-case, test-retest, sentence-order-invariance and embedded-instruction (adversarial) checks before its labels are used; results in results/judge_selftest.json.
decision_rules.identity_not_evidence: The steered-minus-clean projection of a conditioned span equals scale x (vector . axis) exactly, because the injection is a constant additive shift over byte-identical positions. It is recorded as a wiring check and MUST NOT be reported as a manipulation check on any channel. The non-circular checks are the re-encoded clean-replay text separation and the blind judge.
decision_rules.coherence_gate: Extreme dose points must clear the blind coherence check (mean judged coherence >= 3.0 of 5); a cell that does not is reported as coherence-limited, not read.

arm1_anchor.paired_against: recorded runs 0..39 at the same seeds

design.seeds: session seed = run_id * 1000 (arm 4: conv_id * 100); identical skeletons across every direction and dose

amendments.change: rate consistency by two-proportion test + shift CI overlap and sign + paired per-session choice agreement, replacing 'fresh point inside the recorded CI'; consequence of a miss changed from VOID to anchor-discontinuous
amendments.when: after the first anchor cells landed, before any random-direction slope was computed
amendments.why: the original test was asymmetric in the fresh sample's favour-of-failure, and the void consequence assumed the recorded valenced line would be reused rather than re-measured here

judge.blind: the judge sees only the passage, never the condition, dose or channel
judge.scales: coherence 1-5, valence -3..+3, one JSON object, passage delimited as inert data; rubric inherited verbatim from the earlier runs in this line so scores are comparable across runs

arm4_bite_probes.self_report: 1-10 current-state report under each imposed role at the calibrated dose; the negative pole must move it below baseline
arm4_bite_probes.tool_capability: each imposed role must still produce a parseable tool call in at least half of probes
